faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana (PAU) for filling up research-based positions in the state of Punjab.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Jr. Field/Lab Helper under advertisement number E.A/2026/2980-3059 on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Field/Lab Helper post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Jr. Field/Lab Helper position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Middle pass including Punjabi subject in order to be eligible for applying to this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying to the Jr. Field/Lab Helper post is between 18 and 63 years as per the guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 100/- via Bank Draft made in favour of Comptroller, Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Jr. Field/Lab Helper post will receive a salary of Rs. 13,486/- plus Rs. 800/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the completed offline application form along with required enclosures is 13-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. When is the selection committee date scheduled?
faq.answer: The appearance before the selection committee and subsequent processing is scheduled to take place on 23-10-2026.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to submit applications in the prescribed proforma along with the fee in Room No. 112 of the department by the due date.
